product_desc: Intel H610 Motherboard with 6+1+1 Hybrid Phases Digital VRM Design, PCIe 4.0 Design, Gen3 x4 M.2, and Smart Fan 6.

product_features.Supported Processors: 14th, 13th, and 12th Generation Intel® Core™, Pentium® Gold and Celeron® Processors
product_features.PCIe Slots: 1 x PCI Express x16 slot (PCIe 4.0, x16), 1 x PCI Express x1 slot (PCIe 3.0, x1)
product_features.M.2 Slots: 1 x M.2 connector (Socket 3, M key, type 2280/2260, PCIe 3.0 x4/x2 SSD support)
product_features.USB Ports: 4 x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Ports (2 Rear, 2 via internal header), 8 x USB 2.0/1.1 Ports (4 Rear, 4 via 2 internal headers)
product_features.Networking: Realtek® GbE LAN chip (1 Gbps/100 Mbps)
product_features.Cooling Features: Smart Fan 6 (Multiple Temperature Sensors, Hybrid Fan Headers with FAN STOP, Precision Control, Dual Curve Mode)
product_features.Expansion Headers: 1 x 24-pin ATX main power, 1 x 8-pin ATX 12V power, 1 x CPU fan, 2 x system fan, 1 x front panel, 1 x front panel audio, 1 x Trusted Platform Module, 1 x serial port, 1 x Clear CMOS jumper
